items.headline: Vitalik Backs Trueo, $TRUE Explodes 900% in 24H
items.summary: Prediction market Trueo is migrating to Ethereum mainnet, and Vitalik Buterin praised it as 'ethical, not corposlop.' $TRUE surged 900% in 24 hours as traders pile in early.

items.headline: $BCH Rips 27% on CME Futures Listing News
items.summary: $BCH jumped 14% in a single hour after CME announced futures contracts, closing the day up 27% on double the volume. $BSV rode along with a 20% gain.

items.headline: CME to List $UNI Futures, Token Spikes 11%
items.summary: CME Group will offer standard and Micro $UNI futures (10,000 and 1,000 UNI contracts), a major institutional nod for the top DEX token. $UNI spiked 11% on the news.

items.headline: Coinbase Taps $MORPHO for Fixed-Rate BTC Loans
items.summary: Coinbase added fixed-rate bitcoin-backed loans via $MORPHO Midnight, letting users borrow USDC against BTC. Another big CeFi-DeFi integration win for the lending protocol.

items.headline: Mastercard's BVNK Adds $XLM Stablecoin Rail
items.summary: BVNK, acquired by Mastercard for up to $1.8B, has gone live with $XLM-based Stellar rails for stablecoin payments across 130+ markets, with more Stellar-native assets coming.
